Tier Veteran

Activate passive, triggers automatically on a hit

Effect ignores cover entirely and ignores 10 points of Hardness or physical resistance from walls, barricades, or structural interference on a solid connection

Nothing built stands between you and the target for long.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ignores cover entirely and ignores 10 points of Hardness/physical resistance from walls, barricades, or structural interference on a solid connection. Unlike a per-Strike damage rider, this is a bare passive with no system.damage hook to carry the Hardness/resistance-ignoring clause through -- no rule-element key subtracts or bypasses a target/obstruction's own Hardness or resistance value from a bare passive (matches crack-the-plate/nothing-is-cover's own confirmed absence for this effect-class).
